window: Written from about a year of each account's public posts, read on 2026-09-30.

entries.note: Posts like you're already standing in her kitchen and she's mid-story. Thrift store hauls, a husband who says hello, a running forensic file on men who slide into the DMs with four inspirational reels before trying the flirty one. She will make you feel something and then immediately feminise a band name into The Vulva Underground.
entries.line: if you kiss at Olive Garden is that incest?

entries.note: Invented the word wristlace and then refused to let it go, replying to his own joke for days until other people started using it, which he correctly identified as the whole point. A bidet, Star Trek and cornball enthusiast who will die on a hill roughly two inches tall.
entries.line: unlike you guys, i only suffer from posters gladness

entries.note: A heckler with a soft centre. He'll start a YANKEES SUCK chant from the next stall over, confess a fifteen-year crush on Michelle Obama, then quietly tell you about the dog buried under the black cherry tree — and none of it feels like a swerve.
entries.line: The only word I’ve said aloud today is fuck. But in 3 different octaves!

entries.note: Six feet of radioactive decay and candy, self-appointed mother of the website. The jokes are short and land like a dropped glass. She's also the rare poster who can get a laugh out of her father's dementia — telling him Lindsey Graham has died, three separate times in one day — without it curdling.
entries.line: i asked a magic 8 ball if everything was going to be ok and it collapsed in on itself like a dying star is that good

entries.note: Broadcasts from institutions that don't exist. Leaked design scoops, recovered patents, retirement notices redirecting you to JerryVEVO, a late-night radio show where you are caller twelve. Deadpan enough that people reply sincerely, which only encourages him.
entries.line: caller 12 you’re on bluesky at night what’s on your mind

entries.note: Works at Bluesky and posts as though nobody told her, then deletes the evidence — the feed is a crime scene that keeps getting tidied. Horny, bleak and abruptly, completely serious about the thing that actually matters, sometimes inside the same week.
entries.line: the boys are never coming back to town. the boys have been dead for 10 years.

entries.note: A pun factory running three shifts. How I Met Your Mordor. The meow in homeowner. Getting roasted by your kids is getting youthanized. Leaving with a plate you weren't offered is a Mexican goodbye. The bio says “here, I can't see the eye rolls,” which is the only thing keeping him going.
entries.line: what if cats sense you’re dying a little inside and biscuits is just kitty cpr

entries.note: Finds the exact wrong thing to be annoyed about and is completely right. Overnight oats reclassified as a haunted house prop labelled “iced brains.” Baking potatoes he hopes will explode and take the neighbourhood with them. Then he'll turn and be lucidly, unfunnily furious about the state of things, and that lands too.
entries.line: God, grant me the courage to change the things I can and incredible new powers to change the things I can’t.

entries.note: Will do an extended bit about Tolkien running out of dwarf names — borgen, lorgen, forgen, clorgen — and then turn round and defend low-effort posting as a principle. Comedy and conviction share a desk here, and neither one apologises.
entries.line: “wow what a low effort post.” yes. exactly. it’s a post

entries.note: Bio says “just here to have fun online,” which is either a lie or the bravest thing on this list. Builds whole absurd worlds — the Slow Toads-Infused Shrimped Kraut Crumb Lump, a lobby fistfight at a buttmunch burger — and in between is genuinely, articulately furious about the people running things.
entries.line: I climbed up on my shed roof last week and installed a panel to charge my yard tools and now I’m mowing my lawn with power I stole from a fucking star

entries.note: Hockey, Netflix, and a small perfect trilogy of ghost jokes — ghosts only haunt their crush, which makes it a parasocial relationship. Will mute a banger over missing alt text, which tells you the priorities are in order.
entries.line: ghosts only haunt you if you’re their crush

entries.note: Nominally a pizza account, functionally the website's most enthusiastic person. Spent this entire contest campaigning at volume for Greg to win it instead of her, and made the list anyway. Nobody has ever been happier to be here.
entries.line: Dear Bluesky Elders, Tell us stories of the days when Bluesky was fun.

entries.note: Reviewed himself already and it was accurate: used to be funny, now mostly gets mad about trade policy. Both versions are good. Capable of an unhinged close reading of two strangers' necklines, ranking his mutuals by mouthfeel, and real anger about what's happening to his country, in whatever order the day demands.
entries.line: i’ve been going to a weekly support group called Hope but every once in a while they skip a week

entries.note: The menswear guy, on a list of shitposters, entirely on merit. He will give you genuine scholarship on why a brown tweed isn't really brown, and then tell you he dresses exclusively for the approval of dogs, who see in blue and grey. The expertise is real, which is precisely why the swerves work.
entries.line: heartbroken to learn the pope sympathizes with the poor. how can i continue to believe in god

entries.note: Middling jokes and existential dread, sold as a matched set. Every post is a small exact diagnosis you'd rather not have received, delivered by someone who has clearly been awake since 2am reading about uncontacted tribes.
entries.line: A group of people who refuse to get help is called a family

entries.note: A black cat who loves horror, definitely not a witch, lifts heavy stone. Union-organising Home Depot skeletons fighting for bonefits, a cat checkpoint where the toll is one pspsps, and gallows humour that's load-bearing rather than decorative. Will also tell the whole website to stop relating someone's nice post about their kid to the Epstein files.
entries.line: Pour one out for all the guys who can’t talk to their girlfriends because ChatGPT is down

entries.note: Self-described flaming dumpster, and a genuine artist of cheerful self-annihilation. Eight consecutive days in bed re-branded as beast mode. A free mattress that's been out in the rain. A few quiet, peaceful days with his girlfriend, a glazed ham. Delighted that nobody cares what he says.
entries.line: The enemy of my enemy is probably still my enemy, a lot of people don’t like me.

entries.note: Real life is her alt. Turns up in your replies after midnight in lowercase with a pun you'll think about for longer than she did — the first rule of spite club, the early bird's worm thanking God, Scrooge's stolen lunch being hamburgled. Has also issued the closest thing this list has to a manifesto.
entries.line: people should post less whiny and more whimsy

entries.note: Writes jokes the way other people build furniture — the missed connection, the dating profile, the pharmaceutical ad, the serenity prayer, each one loaded and fired in under twenty words. The Onion pays him for this and he's still overqualified.
entries.line: God, grant me the serenity to accept the things I cannot change, courage to change the things I can, and a horse that solves crimes

entries.note: A formalist working almost exclusively in the two-hander. Peter Parker correcting Mary Jane on his uncle's name until she starts singing Barenaked Ladies. Jack and Rose going down with a door pun. The wayward son asking what kind of bag. Nothing is improvised; everything is built.
entries.line: ME: pack a bag, we’re flying to kansas MY WAYWARD SON: what kind of bag

entries.note: Hockey, filth and a goaltender named Bussi whose every conceded goal is a gift she has sworn to keep unwrapping. Knows exactly what this website is doing to her and has made peace with it.
entries.line: therapist: and what should we do when we’re feeling this way? me: keep posting 🙂‍↕️

entries.note: “This is my brain on drugs. No questions at this time.” Mostly turns up to be kind to people in their replies, and then every so often drops something with no joke in it whatsoever that lands harder than anything around it.
entries.line: I should learn how to heal without scabbing over.

entries.note: Named himself Better Things Are Possible and then spends every day describing why they currently aren't, in a voice somewhere between a columnist and a man at the end of his tether. Socrates pulling at the bar despite looking like a beluga whale; an agentic ass now accepting investors.
entries.line: Going to work now feels like doing homework after the teacher quit and told the class that education is fake.

entries.note: Official spokesperson for beavers, and insists you take everything he posts seriously. Heartburn reframed as your body preparing you for dragonhood; HR asking him to stop calling his coworkers mortals. Campaigned for this list openly and shamelessly, which frankly is qualifying behaviour.
entries.line: HR says I need to stop referring to my coworkers as mortals. This feels like discrimination against high deities.

entries.note: Horrors and hot dogs, frequently in capitals, like a haunted supermarket PA. God turning up to ask Margaret what in the holy fuck is going on down there. Hot singles in your area breaking into the lab to melt the cryogenically frozen heads. Bleak, loud, beautifully made.
entries.line: Not a manic pixie dream girl, but a lethargic troll nightmare woman.

entries.note: All lowercase, “tbh” deployed as punctuation, watching the same news as you and saying the thing about four seconds earlier. Then, without warning, a serious question about what single item a junk drawer legally requires to qualify as a junk drawer.
entries.line: in your next zoom interview have not only a cup of ice coffee but seven or eight different cups of various beverages just off camera and casually drink from each

entries.note: Her mom fucked a bat and the rest follows logically. Body-horror whimsy delivered in the tone of someone describing a pleasant weekend: cervical goblins, bursting into bats mid-denial, slipping into something more comfortable by walking into the sea.
entries.line: “All those moments will be lost in time, like cum in the rain…”

entries.note: Has one format and has taken it to places it should not have survived — is it cum, is it a toilet, is it be dead, is it waking up. The rest is chained wordplay in the cadence of a nan telling a story she's told before, punctuated with a single 😬.
entries.line: just like you guys, i put my pants on one leg at a time, leaning against a wall, losing my balance, falling to my knees, yelling “FUCK”

entries.note: Empty inside, full-figured outside, and the warmest person on this list. Rewrote Dylan Thomas in eleven words. Turned her own divorce anniversary into a thread where everyone else got to share something good. Shitposting as hospitality.
entries.line: Do not go willy into that good nilly

entries.note: An Irishman with a recurring sketch about being tased by a zookeeper for shouting puns too loudly. Talonted eagles. Wraptiles. A Superman prequel called Jurassic Clark. He admits some posts are sculpted from wood and others are pumped out like farts, which is the most honest artist's statement here.
entries.line: If a baby hands you a toy telephone to answer, that’s a sign of great respect in their culture.

entries.note: Feral, foul-mouthed, lifts weights, does hair, and is audibly thrilled about a bird in her bird bath. Takes open glee in rich men's rockets exploding and posts good morning with a pink heart to the same audience twenty minutes later.
entries.line: It’s a motherfucking bird in my motherfucking bird bath! These are the things you find exciting when you’re 45.

entries.note: A raccoon who named himself the problem and got on with it. Will sell out faster than limited edition Jordans, holds a genuine grudge against Ed Sheeran, and understands that pointing at the engagement bait is itself engagement bait — which makes him almost impossible to insult.
entries.line: hating on me is just a weak attempt at engagement bait

entries.note: “she/her • i hat typos”, left uncorrected, which tells you everything. Absurd, slightly unwell observations that turn out on inspection to be practical advice. The dik-dik is perfect. The world is not.
entries.line: Live every day like it’s your last. Key a cop car. Eat five hot dogs. Call your boss a taint. Who cares anymore?

entries.note: Co-slave, with a friend, of two cats. Oscillates between genuine fury — at anti-vaxxers, at the weedy little men building the future — and posting floofed-out cat pictures captioned “timeline cleanse.” Has described the operation better than anyone else could.
entries.line: We have two settings: 1) Silly 2) Crushed under the weight of crippling depression

entries.note: Czar for life, master strategist, window installer, wanted in 123 countries. Has been reporting from day 1,391 of his three-day war for years now, and the joke has never once wobbled — partly because it keeps being more informative than the news it's parodying.
entries.line: Do not believe anything until the Kremlin denies it™️

entries.note: Would help lift your spirits but she's got a bad back. Specialises in threats delivered in a lovely voice — measuring twice because your legs won't fit in the freezer — and in being sincerely, disarmingly nice about dogs.
entries.line: There are people out there who don’t kiss the tops of their dogs’ heads at every available opportunity, and we call those people monsters.

entries.note: The strangest voice on the board and the hardest to excerpt, because the posts don't resolve so much as drift — a first job answering elevator phones, the moon advising him to stop crying and start metal detecting, a barstool carried into the woods to gesture at the road less travelled. Twenty-two people knew exactly what they were voting for.
entries.line: Don’t ever let anyone tell you where your wires go. You’ve got the perfect maze of loops and decoys already

entries.note: Gentle surrealism about machines and small indignities. A killbot politely offering to murder you or make a smoothie. Greeting cards for people who biffed it at the Senate meeting. Throwing a little cheese on the oven floor for the oven, as a treat. Not one mean post in three years.
entries.line: hey, remember: don’t eat anything and don’t breathe
